'''Daniel Heefner Hunt Down Annoy The Jedi''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Daniel Heefner]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10880">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10880 Hunt Down Annoy The Jedi], DeckTech (Daniel "Darth Dan" Heefner, 3 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10880/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10880/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018112523/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10880/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

The post also lists 1x Ds-61-s, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''Hunt Down Annoy The Jedi'''
* '''Author:''' Daniel "Darth Dan" Heefner
* '''Published:''' October 3, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Hunt Down deck that is undefeated in Juniors play

=== Strategy ===

Just pull out docking bays for activation. Use M'iiyoom to get males out of hand and into lost pile. Attack with Vader Tarkin and Mara.
